name: A Scarlet Dream Beyond the Library
source:
As Remilia navigates a forest with a wounded Flandre, they discover a mysterious library as their only shelter against the imminent sunrise. Follow the Scarlet sisters' journey as they search for a solution to Flandre's destroyed wings, and meet a mysterious librarian that Remilia... really likes.

[From [url=https://lovelyloom.itch.io/patchy-library]itch.io[/url]]
